description: Analyze a component or directory and generate a step-by-step Design Transformation Blueprint tailored to a studio preset. Writes a Markdown refactor report (default 'UNSLOP-REPORT.md') to disk and returns the 7-pillar scorecard, exact before/after class and token replacements, and prioritized file:line refactoring tasks.

ignore.description: Optional list of additional directory base names to exclude from analysis.

path.description: Component file or directory path to analyze, relative to the server project root (defaults to '.').

preset.description: Target studio design archetype used to compute exact replacement classes and CSS tokens (defaults to 'linear-precision').

report.description: Output file path for the generated Markdown transformation blueprint, relative to project root (defaults to 'UNSLOP-REPORT.md').

name: unslop_refactor_plan
